patch.value: Fold pm package explore, inventory and manage into one installed-package listing with --depth brief|standard|deep, and align the SDK list target and the MCP package tool with it

Follow-up to pm-gh1777, which made pm package list an alias of the static inventory, gave every listing one --fields contract and dropped contributions from default explore/manage rows. Three listings of the same installed set remain, with different costs and evidence: inventory (static, offline, last observed update), explore (runtime-probed activation) and manage (runtime probe plus a live registry check that records update observations). The report's third suggestion was one command with --depth brief|standard|deep, as pm context does: brief = inventory rows, standard = explore activation status, deep = manage freshness. Two inconsistencies to settle in the same change: the SDK runExtension positional target list still maps to explore (src/sdk/extension.ts IMPLICIT_EXTENSION_ACTIONS), while the CLI list subcommand is the inventory; and the MCP pm_package tool exposes catalog/explore/manage but no inventory action (PM_EXTENSION_PACKAGE_ACTION_SUBCOMMANDS). Keep explore and manage as compatibility spellings. Duplicate check: searched fold package explore inventory manage depth listing; no open owner.

One installed-package listing takes --depth brief|standard|deep, where brief reads only manifests and saved state, standard adds the runtime activation probe, and deep adds the live registry check; The SDK list target, the CLI list subcommand and the MCP package tool resolve to the same listing; explore and manage keep working as compatibility spellings with unchanged output
An agent asks for installed packages once, chooses how much evidence to pay for with --depth, and gets the same listing from the CLI, the SDK and MCP
